structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by Boards Within the Department of Health Professions
Licensure of the Practice of Funeral Service, Funeral Directors and Embalmers

law.catch_line: Application for license; how license signed; duration
law.text: All applications for examination for a license for the practice of funeral service shall be upon forms furnished by the Board. All licenses shall be issued or renewed for a period prescribed by the Board, not exceeding two years.
